_comment: DRIP trusted identities. PUBLIC data only. RAW-KEY DET method (RFC 9374 reference / det-gen.py). Two chains: A = 255/14340, the fleet currently flown and the one drip_hierarchy.h describes; B = 1000/2000, retained as a second registration authority so the observer is exercised against more than one. Each chain has its own RAA and HDA key pair. Regenerate with check_hierarchy.py after any edit here or in drip_hierarchy.h.
